k13_k17_implementation_summary.overview: Features K13-K17 extend the remittance module with direct bill processing, adjustments, notifications, history tracking, and advanced analytics

K13_Direct_Bill_Processing.description: Process direct bills for insureds with premium collection

admin_screens.path: Finance > Master > Remittance Master > Direct Bill Configuration
admin_screens.purpose: Configure direct billing parameters, late charges, and insurer setup
key_features: Payment terms and grace period settings
Direct bill insurer setup with credit limits
GL account mapping for receivables and charges

admin_screens.path: Finance > Setups > Remittance Setup > Direct Bill Setup

user_screens.path: Finance > Remittance > Direct Bill > Process Direct Bills
user_screens.purpose: Generate and manage direct bills for insureds

K14_Remittance_Adjustments.description: Create and manage adjustment entries for remittance transactions

admin_screens.path: Finance > Master > Remittance Master > Adjustment Configuration
admin_screens.purpose: Define adjustment types, rules, and approval limits
key_features: Automatic adjustment rules based on conditions

admin_screens.path: Finance > Setups > Remittance Setup > Adjustment Approvals
admin_screens.purpose: Configure approval matrix for adjustments by type and amount

key_features: Reason code selection with detailed notes

K15_Remittance_Notifications.description: Manage automated and manual notification delivery for remittance events

admin_screens.path: Finance > Master > Remittance Master > Notification Templates
admin_screens.purpose: Configure notification templates and delivery rules
key_features: Email template management with rich editor

admin_screens.path: Finance > Setups > Remittance Setup > Notification Channels
admin_screens.purpose: Configure email and SMS delivery infrastructure
key_features: From address and sender name settings

user_screens.purpose: Send notifications and manage delivery queue

K16_Remittance_History.description: Comprehensive history tracking, archival, and audit trail for remittance transactions

admin_screens.path: Finance > Master > Remittance Master > History Settings
admin_screens.purpose: Configure data retention, archival, and audit policies
key_features: Archive retention period (7 years for compliance)
Audit trail configuration for all events

user_screens.purpose: Search and view historical remittance transactions

K17_Remittance_Analytics.description: Real-time analytics dashboards and KPI monitoring for remittance operations

admin_screens.path: Finance > Master > Remittance Master > Analytics Setup
key_features: KPI formula builder with targets and thresholds
Alert rule configuration based on metrics

admin_screens.path: Finance > Setups > Remittance Setup > Analytics Access

user_screens.purpose: View real-time analytics and performance metrics
key_features: KPI cards with trends and targets

unique_features: Grouped grid by insured with expansion
Two-panel layout for details and impact

integrations: Policy management system for policy data

Test templates thoroughly before production use
Implement bounce handling for email notifications
Monitor SMS costs and usage

Balance online retention with performance
Implement efficient archival indexing for retrieval
Comply with data retention regulations
Regular archival job monitoring
Implement data encryption for archived data
Optimize queries for real-time performance
Implement caching for frequently accessed metrics
Consider data warehouse for heavy analytical workloads

Regular KPI review and adjustment

data_flow_summary.K13: Policy Data → Bill Generation → GL Entries → Distribution → Payment Collection
data_flow_summary.K14: Transaction → Adjustment Entry → Approval → GL Impact → Balance Update
data_flow_summary.K15: Event Trigger → Template Selection → Content Generation → Multi-channel Delivery → Status Tracking
data_flow_summary.K16: Transaction Data → Audit Logging → Online Storage → Archival → Long-term Retention → Retrieval
data_flow_summary.K17: Operational Data → KPI Calculation → Dashboard Rendering → Alert Generation → Drill-down Analysis

dependencies: K13 depends on Policy Master for policy and insured data
K14 requires all remittance transaction types for adjustments
K15 integrates with all modules for event-based notifications
K16 tracks history for all K1-K17 transactions
K17 aggregates data from all remittance modules for analytics
shared_components: GL posting service used by K13, K14
Notification service used by K15 and alert systems
Audit trail service used by K16 and all transactional modules
Dashboard framework shared with other analytical modules
